newsitem.title: USA: Durakon sets programs to improve results.
newsitem.headline: Durakon sets programs to improve results.

text.p: Durakon Industries Inc, which reported sharply lower second quarter results, said Tuesday it is implementing programs to offset the impact of lower pricing and to help long-term profitable growth.
Earlier, Durakon, which makes pickup truck bedliners and rollback car carriers, reported second quarter earnings of $0.06 a share, down from $0.42 a year ago.

"Many of the same market and competitive conditions we experienced in the first quarter continue today," David Wright, president, said in a statement. "We are continuing to implement new programs to improve results. Combined with our strong fundamentals, we believe these initiatives will expand our market leadership positions."

Durakon said it is implementing aggressive cost reduction and manufacturing productivity programs and has launched new product programs that are in their initial launch stage and will contribute to earnings in the near future. It also increased bedliner prices in the second quarter.
